fields.description: Issue features editorials and local commentary including a prominent piece on a $50,000 libel suit and arrest of editor Wen R. Phillips involving Justice of the Peace H. W. Penney; criticism of Dade County commissioners’ handling of county funds and calls for economy; reflections on rebuilding and development in Greater Miami after the 1926 hurricane; complaints about deteriorating transportation service under Florida Power & Light; notes on city policy affecting newsboys; discussion of tipping; a report on Dade County Medical Association actions regarding a nurses registry; and extensive sports coverage and promotion tied to the Tunney–Dempsey fight, including radio broadcast plans and local boxing events at Biscayne Fronton.
